angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 841,101 km at 189.27 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.2834 +/- 0.0174 mas (same row, RUWE 0.90): 189.27 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.209 +/- 0.047 solar radii from Kuhn et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KELT-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.459.4281K/abstract): 841,101 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.112 +/- 0.055 solar masses from Kuhn et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KELT-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.459.4281K/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5948 +/- 74 K from Kuhn et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.459.4281K/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Kuhn et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.459.4281K/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kelt-10.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.319, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-10 (pscomppars): spectral type G0 V, from Kuhn et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.459.4281K/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-47 12635: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-10 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.09 dex, from Kuhn et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.459.4281K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-10 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.21748, from Kuhn et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.459.4281K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-10 (pscomppars): age 4.5 Gyr, from Kuhn et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.459.4281K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-10 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.58 km/s, from Steiner et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A.134S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
